German Greetings and Farewells: A1 Phrase Practice

Choose everyday German greetings and farewells by time and relationship. Practise Guten Morgen, Guten Abend and polite leave-taking phrases.

A1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Useful phrases and patterns

A greeting can reflect the time of day and relationship: Guten Morgen in the morning, Guten Abend in the evening, and Hallo in many informal situations. Auf Wiedersehen is a common polite farewell; Bis morgen refers to seeing someone tomorrow. Usage varies by region and setting.

Common mistake to avoid

Guten Abend greets someone in the evening. Gute Nacht usually wishes someone a good night when leaving late or going to bed, rather than opening an ordinary evening meeting.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Guten Morgen, Frau Seidel! Schön, Sie zu sehen.Good morning, Ms Seidel! Nice to see you.
Worked example 2Guten Abend und willkommen zu unserem Treffen.Good evening and welcome to our meeting.
Worked example 3Auf Wiedersehen, Herr Aydin, und einen schönen Tag!Goodbye, Mr Aydin, and have a nice day!
Worked example 4Bis morgen, wir sehen uns wieder im Büro.See you tomorrow; we will see each other at the office.

Practice: complete the phrases

Complete the conventional expression indicated by the time or meaning cue. Use the word form that belongs to the fixed phrase. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: Abend · Morgen · morgen · Wiedersehen

Question 1. Guten ___, es ist acht Uhr früh. (morning greeting)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: Morgen

Guten Morgen is the morning greeting.

Question 2. Guten ___ und willkommen! Es ist neunzehn Uhr. (evening greeting)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: Abend

Guten Abend opens an evening encounter.

Question 3. Auf ___, danke für Ihre Hilfe! (polite goodbye)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: Wiedersehen

Auf Wiedersehen is the conventional polite farewell.

Question 4. Bis ___! Wir treffen uns am nächsten Tag. (tomorrow)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: morgen

Bis morgen points to seeing each other tomorrow.
